# Player

> Player lifecycle: joined / left signals, character helpers, leaderstats.

- Package: `Player` · Category: Data & players
- Starts at server boot: **yes, whenever installed** (it has work to do before its first call)
- Installing it also installs: [Util](Util.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Player")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Player")` (shared/client keys)

## `GaxiaServer.Player`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/PlayerService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Player = GaxiaServer.Player
```

### Functions

- `Player.SetupLeaderstats(player: Player, dict: { [string]: any }): ()`
  Create a leaderstats Folder (if missing) and populate with one ValueObject per dict entry. Existing entries are overwritten (Value updated) so this can be called repeatedly.
- `Player.GetLeaderstat(player: Player, name: string): any`
- `Player.SetLeaderstat(player: Player, name: string, value: any): ()`
- `Player.SetWalkSpeed(player: Player, speed: number): (boolean, number?)`
  Returns (applied, actualSpeed). Clamps to [0, Player.MaxWalkSpeed] as defense-in-depth for every caller: a NEGATIVE WalkSpeed still moves the character (in reverse, at |speed|) while SpeedDetector's baseline floors at max(WalkSpeed, 8) — so the player reads as a speeder and gets flagged once any admin whitelist window expires.
- `Player.SetJumpPower(player: Player, power: number): ()`
- `Player.Teleport(player: Player, cframe: CFrame): ()`
  Authorised teleport. Whitelists the player against TeleportDetector for a short window so the position-delta sample after this CFrame change does not raise a false-positive flag. 2 seconds comfortably covers one or two sampler ticks (SAMPLER_INTERVAL = 0.5s) plus replication lag. The whitelist call is safe whether or not AntiCheat is running (it never starts it), and is skipped when the AntiCheat package is not installed.
- `Player.ForEach(fn: (player: Player) -> ()): ()`

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Player.OnPlayerJoined` — `Signal<Player>`
  ── Signals ── (player) when a player joins (or is already in the game when the service starts), before their character spawns
- `Player.OnPlayerLeft` — `Signal<Player>`
  (player) when a player is leaving the game
- `Player.OnCharacterAdded` — `Signal<Player, Model>`
  (player, character) every time a player's character spawns
